# jcooperkai

> Personal site of jcooperkai (Cooper E.), an agentic engineer in San Diego. It lists my company, my public projects, and how to reach me.

- Site: https://jcooperkai.com/
- GitHub: https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys
- X: https://x.com/jcooperkai
- Email: jcooperkai@gmail.com

## Company

- [Webbify](https://webbify.build/): my company. AI agents rebuild and run small-business websites, each with a live client dashboard.

## Projects

### HisokaOS

https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys/HisokaOS

A 32-bit x86 operating system I wrote from scratch in C and assembly. It boots its own kernel in QEMU to an interactive shell, with paging, PCI, an RTL8139 network driver and a RAM filesystem.

### Transactional Relational Database Engine

https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys/TRDE

TRDE, a database engine I wrote in pure Python with no dependencies: a pager, B+tree indexes, crash-safe transactions, a SQL parser and a query planner.

### The Lazy Driver

https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys/The-Lazy-Driver

Self-driving perception and path prediction on ordinary dashcam footage. It segments lanes and drivable road, tracks vehicles with metric distances, and draws a predicted driving line kept on the road.

### Bill

https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys/Bill

A conversational system that runs on my own machine: a local language model with long-term memory, retrieval, planning and fact checking, paired with a predictive concept graph I built without an ML framework.

### Cache the Cat

https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys/Cache-The-Cat-AI

A pixel-art cat that lives on your Windows desktop. It chats through a local model, remembers context, and runs desktop actions only after you approve them.

### Reachy RL

https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys/Reachy-RL

The Reachy 2 robot in MuJoCo with a local viewer, set up as a base for training reinforcement learning policies from scratch.

### GGUF Token Decoder

https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys/GGUF-Token-Decoder

Turns a local GGUF model's raw token IDs back into text using only the model file.

### Editor Browser

https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys/Editor-Browser

A VS Code extension that opens a full browser tab in the editor area, with audio, video and a real address bar.

### App Installer

https://github.com/jcooperkai-sys/app-installer

A Windows application packaged with an NSIS installer and a command-line interface.

## Private projects

Private repositories. The descriptions below are everything that is public about them.

### Flagger

The traffic proxy in front of my GPU server's local language models. It holds Ollama's port and runs one GPU job at a time, most important first: Webbify clients, then public chat, then my own tools, then background work. It also checks every Webbify service every 15 seconds and restarts any that fail three checks in a row.

### Ducky Studio

My desktop app for working with the models on my GPU server. It has chat with tool calling, scheduled tasks that run against a real model, model downloads with live progress, and a view of both machines.

### Latent Diffusion Image Generator

An image generator on a 6 GB consumer GPU. I instantiate the full latent diffusion architecture myself (U-Net, VAE, CLIP text encoder, DDIM scheduler) and load open pretrained weights into it. It loads on demand and unloads itself when idle.

### Motion-Adapter Video Generator

Short, low-resolution video clips on the same 6 GB GPU, using a motion module added to a Stable Diffusion U-Net. I tracked an older checkpoint that only ever output noise to a fault in how its time layers merge, and switched to AnimateLCM.

### On-Demand Language Model with Web Search

A 4-billion-parameter model (Qwen3-4B) served on demand. It looks things up with a live web-search tool when an answer is time-sensitive.

### Wingwall Neural World

Real driving scenes rebuilt as navigable 3D worlds with Gaussian splatting, made as a place to test a self-driving planner. It reaches 21.5 dB PSNR on held-out views.
